messages.author: bf8b05fad9d71bba
messages.subject: Occumulti error
parts:
Hello,

I'm working on my thesis about the Conservation of native mammals in the Yungas ecoregion of Argentina. I have gathered data from 319 camera traps along a human-transformation landscape in the region. My main objective is to understand how the different variables are affecting the occupancy of mammal species.

To do this, I fit a multi-species occupancy model with detection history of 26 species, using the following covariables: distance to hamlets, distance to cropping, cattle occupancy, and canopy height. All variables are continuous site variables and were statistically significant at mean 0 and sd 1 before modeling.

I am using the community model function to identify the effect of covariates on the mammal community and also on each species. This is the code I am using

 

comu_model_vacas <- communityModel(data_list, # data list

                             occuCovs = list(ranef =  c("Occu_vacas", “"Dist_caserios", "Dist_cultivo")), # site vos

                             detCovsObservation = list(fixed = "effort"), #det covs

                             intercepts = list(det = "ranef", occu = "ranef"),

                             effortCov = "effort", #adding the effort for NAs

                             modelFile = "multmodvacas_SOF")# save the text file

 

vacas.commu <- fit(comu_model_vacas, # Modelo

                   n.iter = 20000, # Iteraciones

                   n.burnin = 1000, # Iteraciones que se queman

                   thin = 5, # Iteraciones adelgazadas

                 chains = 3, # Cadenas (siempre son tres)

                 cores = 3, # Número de nucleos que se usan

                 quiet = T #

)

 However, I couldn't get it to run the model correctly with all the variables together, so I generated one model per covariate. Even so, models with distance covariates still give me this error:

   Error in checkForRemoteErrors(val) :

  3 nodes produced errors; first error: Error in node z[1,17]
Invalid parent values

 

I have not been able to diagnose because the distance covariates do not work and the others do.

 Would you know the reason for this error, wouldn't the global model and the models with distance variables be running for me?

with best regards,

Sofia

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: Occumulti error
parts:
Hi Sofia,
sorry for the late reply. I'd need to see the actual data, but the error in node z[1,17] suggests a problem with calculating occupancy probability for species 1 at station 17. Missing covariate value maybe?

z[species, station] is the binary occupancy status, which is created from the occupancy probability psi [species, station], which in turn comes from the occupancy formula (where only the covariate values are station-specific).

In any case, it doesn't make sense that only the model for one covariate fails and the others run ok. So this suggests some problem with the input data rather than the model structure.
Best,
Jürgen
